title: Entity Tracker Hud
description: Adds a customizable and easy-to-read list of all specific entities near you
body:
![Entity Tracker Title and Banner](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/54d72ddd5384519cb5df44519d2ff733b924ea2e_0.webp)
Entity Tracker gives you a clean HUD showing which loaded entities are currently around you and how many of each are present.

## Features
- Compact in-game HUD with entity icons and live counts
- Tracks currently loaded client-side entities near you
- Shows mobs, animals, and other entity types individually
- Per-entity visibility settings
- Searchable settings screen
- Quick HUD toggle keybind
- Optional Mod Menu integration
- Fully client-side

![Showcase of in-game entity hud](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/436610c02e453aa1360b8ca1873b0d752aac4921.png)

## Default Behavior
By default, mobs and animals are shown in the HUD.

Decorative, misc, vehicle, projectile, and other non-living entity types stay hidden until you enable them in the settings.

## Controls
- `H` - Toggle Entity HUD
- `Open Entity Tracker Settings` - Not bound by default

![Entity hud settings screen](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/f3e281f7c7aa0aa7f39a3ae58fd7b96a5f5ff163.png)
